t: You're beside York House, a historic wing of St James's Palace in its north-western part, overlooking Ambassadors' Court and Cleveland Row. It was built in 1736 for Frederick, Prince of Wales, on his marriage. He lived here for only about a year, until a quarrel with his father drove him from Court. In later times two members of the royal family lived here: Princess Alice, Duchess of Gloucester, and Katharine, Duchess of Kent, the wife of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent.
